final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS f, COUNT(*) AS sz, AVG(s.boxy * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS r FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), a AS (SELECT AVG(sz) AS m FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.r) AS avg_ratio, SUM(g.sz) AS combined_size, AVG(g.sz - a.m) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.sz > a.m
